caption: The drawing depicts a wooden frame structure made of two vertical rectangular wooden planks positioned side by side, connected at the top and bottom by narrower horizontal wooden pieces. The wood is depicted in shades of tan and light brown, with visible wood grain texture. Attached to the outer sides of the upper portion of both vertical planks are two cloth straps, each appearing greyish-blue with a faint red line running lengthwise down the middle. The straps are bent downward as if to form loops and are fastened with what looks like small metal pins or hooks. From the central top wooden bar, a piece of twisted rope hangs down, tied around a short, slightly curved stick or wooden peg, with the ends of the rope continuing down and outwards toward the bottom corners of the frame, where they are attached to the bottom horizontal piece. The background of the image is plain and uncolored. The overall composition is vertically oriented, with the frame and its attached elements centrally placed on the page.
title: Carrier
